comparison.objective: Gauge and sort seven machined blocks; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated part handling, seating in GO/NO-GO gaps, classification, and tray placement versus tool-based fine adjustment and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: All blocks validly checked in order and correctly sorted, with escape penalties, versus two safe repeatable stops within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Measurement-based classification is distinct from closed-loop mechanical tuning; all five versions were read.
